selection: Exploratory purposive selection, not a representative or blinded sample. Two adjacent 2024 BEA quarters inspected after local financial and NHS sources lacked documented admissible alternatives.
semantics: Bounded retrospective release-vintage robustness of published rounded numbers. Superseded estimates are historical release policies, not equal current truths. No economic forecasting or investment recommendation.

rights.statement: BEA states information is public domain unless otherwise noted; numeric transcriptions only, attribution and direct links retained; no logo or endorsement.

qualification.unit: percent change from preceding quarter, seasonally adjusted annual rate
qualification.membership: One fixed GDP centre and the declared real-growth comparator in each coherent release
qualification.rounding: Exact rational evaluation of published one-decimal figures only; no inference about unpublished unrounded estimates. A 0.1 percentage-point published gap is not claimed robust to rounding.
qualification.dependencies: One whole-release choice group per separate case. Never combine quarters as independent groups or mix GDP and comparator vintages inside a release.
qualification.exhaustivity: Q1 contains the two initial current-quarter vintages with GDI available; Q2 contains the three initial GDP releases. Later annual/comprehensive updates excluded explicitly.
